class.name: FoxEffectSlotPolicy
class.brief_description: Acts as a gatekeeper for a [FoxEffectManager], enforcing a maximum limit on how many distinct [FoxEffectInstance] objects can exist simultaneously.

method.name: add_effect
method.description: Attempts to add an effect via the Manager, enforcing the slot limit. Returns [code]true[/code] if successful.

method.name: remove_effect
method.description: Manually removes a tracked slot by its effect ID.

method.name: clear_slots
method.description: Clears all tracked slots and forces the Manager to purge them.

members.member: The maximum number of distinct effect instances this policy will allow.
The internal array tracking the currently managed instances.
Returns [code]true[/code] if the policy has reached its maximum slot capacity.
Returns the number of slots currently occupied.
Returns the number of empty slots remaining.

signal.name: slots_updated
signal.description: Emitted whenever the tracked slots change (added, removed, or refreshed).
